build_directdepthmapper: build a DirectDepthMapper module to estimate obstacle maps from depth images with configurable camera height and thresholds
create_depth2local3d: create a function that projects a depth map to a 3D point cloud with origin in the camera focus
create_pcl_to_obstacles: create a function that counts 3D points in 2D map cells to generate an obstacle map
test_directdepthmapper_forward: test the DirectDepthMapper forward pass with a depth tensor and optional pose matrix to produce an obstacle map
refactor_pcl_to_obstacles: refactor pcl_to_obstacles to replace numpy histogram counting with differentiable PyTorch soft counting
